prompt: Create an original 60 second melodic chiptune instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: pulse-wave lead, triangle bass, noise percussion. Style: clear arpeggiated game-like melody and concise rhythmic phrases. Tempo approximately 128 BPM; D major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: An upbeat and playful electronic track with a distinct chiptune or 8-bit aesthetic. It features bright, synthesized melodies, a driving bassline, and electronic percussion, creating a retro gaming feel.
description.zh: 一首欢快活泼的电子音乐，具有独特的芯片音乐或8位风格。它以明亮的合成器旋律、驱动的低音线和电子打击乐为特色，营造出复古游戏的感觉。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
